entities.summary: Pikyry is a biological reserve in the Alto Paraná Department of Paraguay, on the right bank of the Paraná River, and is one of the sites earmarked as 8 ecological reserve by the Itaipu dam, the largest dam in production in the world, located between Paraguay and Brazil. Located in a natural bay, Pikyry is formed by the stream and its confluence with the river Paraná, and has an area of 1,110 hectares
